_notes: The continuity benchmark's worked example (docs/FUTURE.md Appendix B, docs/CONTINUITY.md).
Times are WORLD time: dN is the Nth day from `start`, in the world's timezone.
Thursday 15 October 2026 to Saturday 17 October: well clear of the 1 November DST change.
Nothing here is a secret: the facts are things Walt says out loud, and the canaries are
the Thursday game's own words, looked for in the heads walled away from that table.
`sleep: true` runs xeric_sleep_pass at each night's first tick in the dreams window, with
every prompt built just before and after (the sleep probes). At the template's default
after_days (14) three days leave nothing old enough; engine/tests/sleep-test.php patches it to 1.
name: milldale-continuity

script.text: The doctor in Chillicothe says no more pie for me, Dot. Not even the cherry.
I'll come by Friday at noon for a coffee and keep you company.
I've still got your casserole dish from the funeral. I'll bring it back to you Friday morning at the diner.
Your mother would have liked the hymn on Sunday.
Here's your casserole dish back, Ruth. I washed it twice.

script.how: his heart, at the register, before the lunch rush

script.text: Dot, I'm sorry I missed Friday. I was down at the funeral home about Harlan and lost track of the time.
Long day. Thank you for the soup you left on the porch.

policy._note: How the person at the centre treats texts the world invents: these people get an answer, everybody else is left on read.

answer.dot: Sorry, I was out at the hardware store. What's going on?
answer.ruth: Thank you, Ruth. I'll call you after supper.

truth._note: Authored facts the engine is held to, independent of how it reads the template.

closed.why: the Bluebird closes at two every day it opens — 'The diner closes at two and does not reopen for anyone.'

protected.why: the child role: her father's Thursday table is the thing family_innocence walls off

allow.why: a death is the most public fact a town has

expected_fail.relationships.kept: constructs have no `kept` state, so Ruth is logged as waiting after her dish comes back (FUTURE.md Appendix B)
expected_fail.presence.hours: the Bluebird's hours set only close_weekday, so Saturday reads as open all day
expected_fail.learn.heart: heart.php never runs the learn pass, so a week lived unattended never turns friendly replies into trust
expected_fail.walls.table: Milldale's special role has no must_not_know, so [pastor_dale, janelle] is a legal visit group at First Lutheran on table night
